objective: Backlog B5 of the goals doc, taken at the coordinator's go-ahead under the owner's standing mandate for autonomous research (2026-11-08): does the native creation map of a plain edge-atom space depend on the signing of its glue only through the signing's switching class? status: Complete 2026-11-08: successful.
